senses.gloss:
तिथ m. (-थः)
 1. Fire.
 2. KĀMA^1 or love.
 3. Time.
 E. तिथ् to inflame,
Uṇādi affix थक्, and the radical final rejected.
[1] Correction submitted by Scott Rhodes on 20260617. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/264.

तिथिक्षय m. (-यः) Day of new moon.
 E. तिथि, and क्षय destruction. तिथीनां
तिथ्युपलक्षितचन्द्रकलानां क्षयः क्षयारम्भो-यस्मिन् ।

तिथिप्रणी m. (-णीः) The moon.
 E. तिथि a lunar day, प्र before, णी to get
or obtain, affix क्विप् ।
